mode: Ten linked sequential exploratory observational experiments; not independent replications or confirmatory tests
development_exposure: Gaia positions/quality and LAMOST rows already accessed by CP001; P01-P04 are retrospective descriptive tests, not preregistered discovery evidence

experiments.name: Proper-motion relevance
experiments.question: Does epoch propagation change reported-ID separation from the LAMOST fiber?
experiments.decision_rule: Compare ref_epoch and obsdate separations; report changes >=0.1 arcsec; no counterpart certification

experiments.name: Crowding sensitivity
experiments.question: Does candidate ambiguity change as the positional aperture expands?
experiments.decision_rule: Count Gaia candidates at obsdate within 1,2,3,6 arcsec; missing motion stays explicit

experiments.name: Astrometric reliability
experiments.question: How many sources pass a conservative Gaia astrometry screen?
experiments.decision_rule: Complete PM/errors; ruwe<=1.4; duplicated_source false; ipd_frac_multi_peak<=2; thresholds are pilot policy, not source-normality proof

experiments.name: Repeated spectroscopic parameters
experiments.question: Are repeated reported-ID WD temperature/gravity estimates compatible at measurement-only precision?
experiments.decision_rule: Use all staged WD observations for frozen reported IDs; non-sentinel positive errors; pair differences/max summed errors>3 flags conservative tension; ID association remains provisional

experiments.name: AllWISE coverage and epoch sensitivity
experiments.question: Are unique positional AllWISE candidates present for this cohort?
experiments.decision_rule: Retrieve all candidates within 15 arcsec of Gaia PM position at 2010.5; compare 2009.5/2010.5/2011.5 support at 3 arcsec; no forced association

experiments.name: WISE detection versus upper limit
experiments.question: Which infrared bands retain measured uncertainties and clean quality flags?
experiments.decision_rule: Unique provisional match; per-band ph_qual A/B, cc_flags=0, snr>=5, finite positive magnitude error, rchi2<=2, sat<=0.01, ext_flg=0, nb=1, na=0; U remains upper limit

experiments.name: W1-W2 color distinguishability
experiments.question: Are measured clean W1-W2 colors distinguishable from the zero-color reference?
experiments.decision_rule: Compute color and uncertainty under independent errors plus full correlation bounds; conservative |color|>3*(sigma1+sigma2); zero color is an instrumental reference, not a validated WD photosphere; no excess claim

experiments.name: 2MASS coverage with native epochs
experiments.question: Do 2MASS candidates retain a unique positional association when native JD is used?
experiments.decision_rule: Retrieve 15 arcsec cone at year 2000, propagate Gaia separately to each native jdate; unique within 3 arcsec only; missing epoch unresolved

experiments.name: Near-infrared color measurements
experiments.question: Which J-H and H-K colors have clean measured uncertainties?
experiments.decision_rule: Unique provisional 2MASS candidate with ph_qual AAA, cc_flg 000 and positive finite combined magnitude errors; preserve color errors and maximum-correlation bounds, no atmosphere inference

experiments.name: Joint model-readiness gate
experiments.question: Is any source ready for a later multi-band WD atmosphere experiment?
experiments.decision_rule: Require P03 astrometry screen, unique provisional survey candidates, clean JHK+W1W2; independently certified counterpart/image/model validation still required, so this run cannot authorize an excess search

acquisition.failure_policy: Any TAP overflow/error/checksum/transport failure is blocked, never zero matches

scientific_limits: All associations conditional; no physically certified counterpart in this cohort
No reference-star control group or validated WD atmosphere model
No global false-alarm calibration or independent samples
No technology/alien or physical excess inference
Ten protocols include prerequisite/feasibility experiments, not ten independent discovery tests

repeat_supplement.amendment: P04 repeat-spectra supplement; original ten-source P04 not testable
repeat_supplement.scope: Exploratory amendment driven by absence of repeat data, not by parameter differences
repeat_supplement.selection: Require >=2 observations sharing reported Gaia ID and >=2 non-sentinel estimates with positive errors in at least one parameter; fixed hash ranking first10; do not inspect differences for selection

amendment_reason: Original P04 cohort has no repeats; preserve non-testable result and use availability/hash-selected repeat supplement only for P04
